docTitle.zh: Wrisp — 今天，你需要一个创作分身
docTitle.en: Wrisp — Today, you need a creation twin

docDesc.zh: 说话代替打字，整理交给 AI，数据永远留在你的机器。通用 AI 帮你写作，Wrisp 为你创作。
docDesc.en: Talk instead of type. AI does the organizing. Your data stays on your machine. Generic AI helps you write. Wrisp creates for you.

jsonldDesc.zh: 本地优先的个人创作 AI：对话式输入、日志流、信息卡片、检索问答与作品创作。通用 AI 帮你写作，Wrisp 为你创作。
jsonldDesc.en: A local-first AI for personal creation: conversational capture, a journal stream, info cards, retrieval-based answers and piece creation. Generic AI helps you write. Wrisp creates for you.

jsonldOfferDesc.zh: Community 免费，AI 用量走用户自带 Key（BYOK），不代扣模型费用。
jsonldOfferDesc.en: Community is free. AI usage runs on your own API key (BYOK); we never bill model costs on your behalf.
